latest_update.text: Salam, subitem breakdown for Phase 2 Backlog, future state, not building now: Lead scoring model (incident to treatment gap, fault type): Sharif's own framework. Strongest signal is the gap between date of incident and date of first treatment, 2+ weeks untreated usually means decline barring rare circumstances. Fault type matters, rear ended beats left turn liability. Severity/surgery usually isn't knowable until months into treatment. Build once volume justifies it, Sharif's words were "when there's volume." Incident and treatment date fields already live in Pipeline Build. AI document auto labeling, gated on compliance confirmation: renaming uploaded images by what they are (license, insurance card). Sharif is fine with it as long as data never leaves Flow Company plus the firm. Medical

latest_update.author: Nacer Amrouch
latest_update.text: Salam, Maadi Law sends an automatic acknowledgement when a lead comes in, then chases it about three hours later if the thread still looks unanswered. The firm sent us a screenshot of that chase firing again and asked why. The lead had actually come through the IVR and spoken to the firm, but because there was no typed reply, the workflow counted it as silence and chased anyway. Only a typed reply stops it today, so every phone conversation still looks unanswered to the system. We need an inbound or answered call, IVR included, to stop the follow-up the same way a reply does, we've already told the firm this is coming. We also need to fix whatever the workflow actually checks for a reply today, then prove it on a dummy contact down both paths, reply-only and call-only, and confirm the chas
